q4_recommendation.detail: Robots-clean, officially documented alternatives exist (oaipmh.arxiv.org /oai and rss.arxiv.org /rss/ — both robots.txt 404 => allowed under RFC 9309), so the robots conflict can be AVOIDED without owner override. But every arXiv machine interface is bound by the ToU 1 req/3 s + single-connection limit, which the transport cannot enforce and which the admission code itself DEFERs (PER_SECOND / CONCURRENCY NOT_ENFORCEABLE). Once per-host pacing (>=3 s, 1 connection, process-wide) exists: ADMIT_ALTERNATIVE host=rss.arxiv.org prefix=/rss/ (daily, <=1 fetch per category per day) and host=oaipmh.arxiv.org prefix=/oai (incremental from=<yesterday>), maxRequestsPerSecond=0.333, maxConcurrency=1, cache 24 h. Keep export.arxiv.org/api/query as OWNER_DECISION.
